review.why: Builds accessible interfaces with shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS and canvas-based visual designs, from setup to dark mode and theming.
review.summary: Describes a stack of shadcn/ui components on Radix primitives, Tailwind utility styling and a canvas layer for posters and visual compositions, with a bundled set of fonts. A quick start runs the shadcn init and add commands. It lists when to use it, from accessible dialogs and forms to dark mode and responsive layouts, and links the shadcn and Tailwind docs.
strengths: Clear stack description with copy-paste component model
Covers accessibility, dark mode and responsive layout
Bundles open-license fonts for canvas designs
cautions: Later sections and canvas guides were not read in full
Quick start runs package commands in the user's project
